body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 15:45Z, my own miss). Never tell a worker to read, diff or inspect ANOTHER session's worktree while that worktree has a gate or check running. Even a read-only `git` or `pwsh` command whose cwd or -C points into that root counts as "another writable session reached its worktree", and the host refuses the gate's credit. Cost: TRAIN-4's carrier test-9cc1d81e PASSED 5/5 but earned no credit (Sol-a7bb ran pwsh in .tmp/wt-train4-… while it ran), so a full rerun was needed. To compare against another tree, give the worker OBJECT ids (commit, tree, blob) and have it run git in its OWN root.
